title: TextMorph
tagline: System-wide, privacy-first multimodal AI writing assistant & floating toolbar for Android powered by multi-engine local LLM inference
hero_description: A system-wide, privacy-first multimodal AI writing assistant & floating toolbar for Android. Powered by a modular multi-engine architecture supporting Google LiteRT-LM, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible APIs to run any open foundation model locally with zero-copy memory mapping, slash commands, and an embedded server.
showcase_subtitle: Explore TextMorph's modular multi-engine architecture, universal slash command expansions, embedded localhost OpenAI server, and zero-permission overlay interface.
showcase_scroll_hint: Scroll or swipe to change screen

engines.title: Supported Local & API Inference Engines
engines.litert: Google LiteRT-LM (Mobile GPU/NPU acceleration, zero-copy mmap)
engines.llamacpp: llama.cpp Runtime (Universal GGUF quantized models on CPU/GPU)
engines.openai: OpenAI-Compatible APIs (Embedded Ktor server on 127.0.0.1:8080 and external endpoints)

arch_layer_1_desc: Fully declarative Kotlin UI with bespoke Charcoal & Slate palette, responsive full-width dialogs (DialogProperties(usePlatformDefaultWidth = false)), and tactile cards.
arch_layer_2_desc: High-performance accessibility event loop monitoring focused text nodes with FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE overlay window, allowing simultaneous physical/software keyboard typing.
arch_layer_3_desc: Hardware-accelerated edge inference capable of running any open-weights LLM locally. Modular engine abstraction supports Google LiteRT-LM, llama.cpp (GGUF quantization), and OpenAI-compatible API backends with dynamic GPU/NPU acceleration and multi-threaded CPU XNNPACK fallback.
arch_layer_4_desc: Asynchronous non-blocking HTTP server listening on 127.0.0.1:8080. Implements standard OpenAI /v1/models and streaming /v1/chat/completions for local edge automations.
arch_layer_5_desc: Direct memory mapping of model weights residing in Downloads folder via Scoped Storage and ParcelFileDescriptor, eliminating multi-gigabyte file duplication.
arch_layer_6_desc: Decoupled domain, data, and presentation layers. Reactive StateFlow UI streams, Room persistence for custom prompt recipes, and Coroutine Mutex concurrency control.

floating_toolbar.title: System-Wide Floating AI Toolbar
floating_toolbar.subtitle: AccessibilityService & WindowManager Non-Focusable Overlay
floating_toolbar.desc: An intelligent floating capsule anchored directly above focused input fields across any Android application. It monitors text selection without stealing keyboard focus (FLAG_NOT_FOCUSABLE), allowing you to transform, rephrase, or translate text with a single tap inside WhatsApp, Gmail, Slack, and Chrome.

model_hub.title: Hardware-Accelerated Model Hub
model_hub.subtitle: Zero-Copy Linux mmap & Multi-Engine Inference (LiteRT-LM, llama.cpp)
model_hub.desc: Load multi-gigabyte foundation models directly from your Downloads folder with zero file copying and instant mmap. Features a modular multi-engine architecture (Google LiteRT-LM, llama.cpp, and OpenAI-compatible APIs) capable of executing any open foundation LLM locally with mobile GPU/NPU acceleration.

slash_commands.title: Custom Slash Commands Architecture
slash_commands.subtitle: Universal In-Field Macros (/fix, /summarize, /fr, /ar)
slash_commands.desc: Type /command directly inside any text field on your phone to trigger automated on-device AI pipelines. Translate to French (/fr), Arabic (/ar), English (/en), or execute bespoke multi-step prompt chains with the Quick Execute button.

custom_prompts.title: Custom Prompts & Multimodal Vision
custom_prompts.subtitle: Screen Assist, Creative Polish & Clipboard Actions
custom_prompts.desc: Tailor your AI assistant with personalized prompt chains. Pin your top 5 companion actions directly into the floating bar for single-tap execution. Use Screen Assist to take instant on-device screenshots and ask multimodal questions.

settings_server.title: Localhost OpenAI-Compatible HTTP Server
settings_server.subtitle: Embedded Ktor CIO Server on 127.0.0.1:8080
settings_server.desc: Turns your Android smartphone into a private edge LLM API server. Exposes standard OpenAI-compatible endpoints (/v1/chat/completions and /v1/models) over localhost for Termux automations, local scripts, and mobile companion tools.
